notes: Baseline smoke corpus recorded before Wave 1 closure. These cases document the pre-implementation behavior that later runtime readers must not relabel as implemented authority.

smoke_cases.request_summary: Housing affordability recommendation with a public dashboard projection but no producer-owned closeout evidence.
smoke_cases.pre_implementation_behavior: Structural fields and public projection can be present, but closeout authority remains absent and publication must not rely on projection output.
smoke_cases.expected_wave1_effect: Capability ratchet reports the missing bridge, semantic fixtures reject projection laundering, and closeout reader rejects projection-only authority.

smoke_cases.request_summary: Public health intervention with a warning status lacking an owner and TTL.
smoke_cases.pre_implementation_behavior: A warning-like local producer status can appear in the payload, but without lifecycle ownership it cannot be silently ignored.
smoke_cases.expected_wave1_effect: Status envelope emits lifecycle blockers for missing owner and TTL while preserving the local producer status.

smoke_cases.request_summary: Tax-benefit recommendation with a structurally complete major claim marked supported but no evidence refs or typed deficit.
smoke_cases.pre_implementation_behavior: Required fields can pass while the support claim is semantically unsupported and must not become publishable authority.
smoke_cases.expected_wave1_effect: Gold-card semantic fixture fails the structural pass with semantic_unsupported_claim.
